messages:
zara: heads-up — us-west2 showing a sharp eviction ripple starting 11:10 UTC, mostly tiny-gang jobs getting Preempted :warning:
pete: confirmed. lots of nodes reporting high egress-drop counts and kubelet marking them NotReady intermittently
infra-bot: alert: egress-quota-exceeded on us-west2-egress (peer: cloud-provider-egress-3). Affected nodes: gpu-node-usw2-[04..11]
mohammed: pasted sample from node metrics: `egress_errors_total: 1200 -> 7800 in 3m` and `conntrack_drops: 0 -> 450`
claire: did we hit a new cloud egress quota or is this a transient spike? any recent change to egress routing or NAT gateways?
infra-bot: config-push: nat-gateway-scaling by netops@redwood at 11:05 UTC (change-id: nat-2026-04-09-11). Scaled NAT pool from 2 -> 1 to test cost optimization.
zara: that would explain it — fewer NAT endpoints -> conntrack overload -> pod egress failures -> kubelet network health degrades -> scheduler preempts and evicts under pressure
pete: mitigation: I flipped nat-gateway-scaling back to 2 and restarted CNI on affected nodes, also temporarily bumped warmpool-min in us-west2 from 2 -> 7 for 40m to absorb reschedules
ops-bot: action created: NET-6099 revert-nat-scaleback-and-investigate (assigned to netops)
mohammed: metrics reacting: pod_evictions peaked 4 -> 62 in 6m, now down to 13 after mitigation. conntrack_drops falling.
claire: cost FYI: 40m warmpool bump estimates to +$4.5k on Dedicated commit. short window — acceptable for stability but track to the budget owner
zara: follow-ups: 1) add CI check preventing nat-pools < 2 in gpu clusters; 2) add alert "conntrack_drops > 100/min on GPU nodes"; 3) postmortem to capture exact rollout that allowed nat scaleback without canary
pete: i'll open NET-6100 (CI guard) and MON-1102 (conntrack alert). mohammed can you gather kubelet events + conntrack state for the affected nodes and attach to NET-6099
mohammed: on it. saving conntrack dump and kubelet journal now
zara: recap: cause = nat pool scaleback for cost test -> conntrack overload -> node network degraded -> scheduler evictions; mitigation = revert scaleback + restart CNI + warmpool bump; follow-ups created. thanks all.
